description.zh: 是否同步清理Stack管理的资源，默认不清理
description.en: Specifies whether to synchronously clean up resources managed by the stack. By default, resources are not cleaned up.

description.zh: StackId，Stack 创建后的唯一标识
description.en: The stack ID. This is the unique identifier generated after the stack is created.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iacservice delete-stack --stack-id stack-as1d4vld898ppnqbxxxxx --clean-resources true --api-version 2021-08-06 --region cn-hangzhou
